product.title: Portland City Tour

description.text: Visit popular Portland attractions on a guided small-group tour with stops at Voodoo Doughnut, Hoyt Arboretum, Pittock Mansion, and the International Rose Test Garden. A local guide narrates the route through parks, viewpoints, and city landmarks before returning to your hotel pickup point.

highlights: Small-group Portland sightseeing with a local guide
Stops at Pittock Mansion and the International Rose Test Garden
Drive through Hoyt Arboretum and downtown corridors
Sweet snack stop at Voodoo Doughnut
Hotel pickup and drop-off in the Portland area

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Visit popular Portland attractions on a guided small-group tour with stops at Voodoo Doughnut, Hoyt Arboretum, Pittock Mansion, and the International Rose Test Garden.

itineraryItems.title: Downtown Portland
itineraryItems.description: Begin with drive-by views of central Portland districts and waterfront corridors.

itineraryItems.title: Voodoo Doughnut
itineraryItems.description: Stop for a sweet snack at one of Portland's iconic doughnut shops.

itineraryItems.title: Hoyt Arboretum
itineraryItems.description: Drive through tree-filled paths in Washington Park's arboretum area.

itineraryItems.title: Pittock Mansion
itineraryItems.description: Stop for city and mountain views from the historic estate overlook.

itineraryItems.title: International Rose Test Garden
itineraryItems.description: Walk among rose varieties in Washington Park when blooms are in season.
